record.question: In XYZ Hospital there were 18 deaths in July 2025 and 3 of the deaths occurred within 48 hours of admission. The total discharges including all the deaths were 423. Find the net death rate for July 2025.
record.explanation: Answer B: 3.6%. Net death rate excludes deaths occurring within 48 hours from both the death numerator and the total discharges (including deaths) denominator. Reference: https://iris.who.int/bitstream/handle/10665/42079/9241545186_eng_part1.pdf?sequence=1; https://ccpsh.org/sites/default/files/tools/Guidebook%20on%20PPP%20in%20Hospital%20Management.pdf.
